newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,658 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,658 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 2,658 contracts compared with 1,845 overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 57 wheat, 756 corn, 1,642 soybean, 114 soymeal, 40 soyoil, two oat, two corn calls, 30 soybean calls and 15 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 1/2 cent lower, corn was 1/4 to 2-3/4 cents lower and soybeans were unchanged to 6-1/4 cents higher.
